day_off.still: Attendance can still be taken (an extra class).

today.title: Attendance
today.text: Each section's attendance of the day: tap a section to take it or look at it.
today.waiting_offline: {count} attendance sheets are kept on this device and will be sent when the network is back.
today.no_sections_text: You are not class teacher of a section or teacher of a subject in an open session here. Ask the head teacher to name you.
today.no_periods: No periods are set for this campus yet.

sheet.title: Attendance
sheet.offline_note: No network: this sheet is kept on this device and sent when the network is back.
sheet.subject: Subject
sheet.no_periods: Attendance here is taken in each period, but this campus has no periods yet. Ask the office to add them.
sheet.read_only: You can look at this sheet but not change it (not your section or subject, or the day is too old for teachers).
sheet.no_students: No students in this section yet
sheet.not_saved: Not saved yet: everyone starts present
sheet.note_hint: For example: ill, leave letter, came at 10.
sheet.offline_off: No network, and offline work is not on for this device. Turn it on in Offline mode, or try again when the network is back.
sheet.kept_offline: No network: kept on this device. It will be sent when the network is back.
sheet.merged: Someone saved this attendance meanwhile. Theirs is shown with your changes on top: check and save again.
sheet.leave_text: The changes you made on this sheet will be lost.

register.title: Monthly register
register.text: A section's month: each school day's attendance and each student's totals.
register.empty_text: Attendance has not been taken for this section in this month.
register.caption: Attendance of {section}, {month}
register.legend: P present · A absent · L late · LV leave · a dot: no attendance that day. School days are the days attendance was taken.

periods.title: Periods
periods.text: A campus's periods of the day, used when attendance is taken in each period.
periods.rule_off: Attendance is taken once a day here. Periods are used when the rule "Attendance in each period" is on.
periods.empty_text: Add the periods of the day (1st, 2nd…) with their times.
periods.number_hint: Its place in the day: 1 for the first period.
periods.name: Name
periods.conflict: Someone changed this period a moment ago. The list is fresh now; change it again.
periods.remove_text: A period attendance was taken in cannot be removed; switch it off instead.

holidays.title: Holidays
holidays.text: Days the institution is closed beyond the weekly days off.
holidays.empty_text: Add holidays such as Victory Day or the Eid vacation.
holidays.name: Name
holidays.remove_text: These days will no longer show as a holiday.
